Chapter 761: Chapter 37: Pushing The Door Open (Subscribe Please)_2

Chapter 761: Chapter 37: Pushing the Door Open (Subscribe Please)_2

Boom, boom, boom.

Just at this moment,

the nine Supreme Beings of Human Civilization suddenly unleashed a terrifying aura, recklessly stirring the spacetime fluctuations of hundreds of thousands of light-years nearby.

“Hmm?”

“Human Civilization? Have they activated the Clan Suppression Weapon?”

“Activating the Clan Suppression Weapon comes at no small cost. What does Human Civilization intend to do?”

...

“What to do? Naturally, to protect that ‘Blood Rain’, right?”

The thoughts of the Supreme Beings processed at an astonishing speed, immediately understanding the reason behind the actions of the nine Supreme Beings.

If Lin Yuan could push open the Heavenly Gate this time, freeing himself from the Two-dimensional World and returning to the Main Universe, he would inevitably be exposed right under the noses of the many Supreme Beings present.

And with Lin Yuan’s stunning performance in the Two-dimensional World, there would definitely be Supreme Beings who couldn’t control themselves and would directly attack, such as the Insect Race, the Matriarch of the Tianyu Clan, and the Ancestors.

Or maybe some other ultimate beings, if given the chance, would certainly seize the opportunity to strike.

“Humph, for a mere life within the River of Time, such a grand mobilization, the Supreme Beings of Human Civilization… tsk tsk…”

“A grand mobilization, if you had offspring like ‘Blood Rain’, I reckon it would be even more exaggerated than what Human Civilization is doing now.”

…

The many Supreme Beings communicated with each other, but they didn’t have any objections or aversion to the actions of Xia Qin Supreme Being and the other eight Supreme Beings; in fact, they even voluntarily backed off a bit, showing their sincerity.

One reason was that since Lin Yuan had freed himself from the constraints of the Two-dimensional World and returned to the Main World, even if his avatar died, there would be no fundamental loss; hence, the significance of killing him wasn’t significant.

Secondly, they too had tribe members trapped in the Two-dimensional World. After Lin Yuan left the Two-dimensional World, the other powerhouses of the Myriad Tribes would also successively push open the Heavenly Gate and leave.

If they struck at Lin Yuan now, when their tribe members left the Two-dimensional World, would the nine Supreme Beings of Human Civilization just let it go?

Rather than killing a thousand enemies and losing eight hundred of themselves, it was better to take a step back.

Of course, this was just the idea of the majority of ultimate beings. A few Ancestors of the Tianyu Clan thought differently.

Because the Tianyu Clan powerhouses who had fallen into the Two-dimensional World had been eliminated right from the beginning and had no chance of leaving the Two-dimensional World at all.

Yet merely relying on the few Ancestors of the Tianyu Clan would not shake the nine Supreme Beings of Human Civilization who had activated the Clan Suppression Weapon.

“No suspicions have been raised…”

Xia Qin Supreme Being and the other eight Supreme Beings exchanged glances and slightly relaxed.

Currently, the aura of Human Civilization’s Clan Suppression Weapon still pervaded half of the ‘scroll’, so even a Supreme Being could not decipher the aura of the ‘Blood Rain’ who had escaped the Two-dimensional World.

The reason Xia Qin Supreme Being and the other Supreme Beings acted this way was only partially guessed by the ultimate beings present.

The real reason was to cover up Lin Yuan’s true identity.

If the many ultimate beings sensed that the ‘Blood Rain’ escaping the Two-dimensional World was merely a Tenth Rank Life,

then likely all the ultimate beings present would have thoughts of attacking.

What a joke, for a Tenth Rank Life to beat and crush legendary lives of Eleventh Rank Complete like the Four Divine Kings.

Even the nine Supreme Beings of Human Civilization were somewhat frightened and admitted that if other forces had such a monstrous figure, they would also take action to eliminate them.

Luckily, the many ultimate beings did not think in this direction at all and just assumed the nine Supreme Beings of Human Civilization were purely protecting that ‘Blood Rain’.

In fact, this assumption was not wrong. If Lin Yuan had not actively revealed himself, the nine Supreme Beings of Human Civilization would also have regarded that ‘Blood Rain’ as a Legendary Life of Eleventh Rank Perfection.

…

The Two-dimensional World.

Atop the Heavenly Mountain.

Lin Yuan stood quietly in front of the Heavenly Gate which was gradually materializing from the ethereal.

Soon,

The Heavenly Gate was completely manifested.

The thick fluctuations of spatial power rippled outward in all directions like ripples.

Lin Yuan stood before the Heavenly Gate, not yet pushing it open but instead letting the memories of the past ten thousand years flicker through his mind.

Ten thousand years, it certainly was the longest period Lin Yuan had experienced since he identified himself as an Evolver.

Although only a century had passed in the Main Universe, the ten thousand years in the Two-dimensional World were still real.

Lin Yuan only needed to think back slightly, and everything that had happened over the past ten thousand years appeared before his eyes.

“Even if I still can’t push it open this time, I will still wait for the next ten thousand years, and the next one beyond that…”

Without yet beginning to push the Heavenly Gate, Lin Yuan had already prepared for the worst scenario.

After all, the last time the Heavenly Gate opened, Lin Yuan had exerted all his strength, yet he could not move it at all,

Even though his strength had indeed increased significantly since then.

But whether he could ultimately open the Heavenly Gate or not, Lin Yuan still had no confidence.

“Let’s begin.”

Lin Yuan gathered his thoughts and gently placed his hands on the Heavenly Gate.

The next moment,

the originally sealed Heavenly Gate slowly began to open.

“Hmm?”

Lin Yuan was slightly startled; he had just placed his hands on the Heavenly Gate without even applying any force, yet the gate had opened?

Even Lin Yuan felt that even if it weren’t him standing before the Heavenly Gate, but rather an ordinary person, they could still easily push it open?

“What exactly is going on?”

Lin Yuan’s thoughts fluctuated; ten thousand years ago, he hadn’t used his Physical Body Divine Ability ‘Enhancement’, yet he couldn’t move the Heavenly Gate at all.

Now, he just placed his hands on it, and it easily opened?

This stark contrast made Lin Yuan involuntarily speculate.

Whether the Heavenly Gate could be opened was not related to one’s own strength; was it about whether the ‘Heavenly Gate’ itself was willing to be opened?
